title: Add real exafy_admin auth to approvals.ts and governance-controls.ts (route-auth-scanner-v1 missing_auth finding)

mutation_verified.method: commented out router.use(requireAdminAuth) in both route files, restored from backup after
mutation_verified.result: 15/27 tests in the two route-level suites correctly failed

internal_callers_audited_and_fixed.before: no auth headers at all on the approvals self-call
internal_callers_audited_and_fixed.after: Authorization: Bearer <id.user_jwt> via new authHeaders(id), matching the established pattern

internal_callers_audited_and_fixed.before: Authorization: Bearer <SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE> (a DB credential, not a user JWT -- would have been rejected by requireAdminAuth)
internal_callers_audited_and_fixed.after: in-process calls to the extracted services/approvals-service.ts (no HTTP hop, no bearer token needed); dev_approve_item/dev_reject_item additionally gated by isExecuteTaskAuthorized(getThreadAuth(threadId)), the same check VTID-03851 already requires for autopilot_execute_task
